methods.name: DUALIZE
methods.outcome: success: exact initial-vector localized leakage functional from the Sylvester/Feshbach low-energy projection replaces the uniform rho*||f|| leakage term for a fixed likelihood ratio

methods.name: DO ONE SCALE, ONE DIRECTION AT A TIME
methods.outcome: success: signed/cancellative algebraic-degree band norms obey a Metzler comparison semigroup with an exact Dyson path barrier and a finite-bandwidth distance corollary

methods.name: ATTACK THE NEGATION FIRST
methods.outcome: success: source-scale family has Adv<=D exactly zero, relative commutator Theta(1/D), enormous pre-noise chi-square, but fixed-noise chi-square and TV tending to zero; global second-moment leakage multiplier is not necessary
